name: public_ds2_v9_personal_force_calibration_v0
source_training_and_subject_splits: identical to the fixed zero-shot DS2 v9 force screen; validate zero-shot probabilities against its saved trial rows before any calibrated score
eligibility: only four active gesture codes 0-3, verified subject folder and uniform gesture/force trial labels; exclude Rest, mixed gesture and subject-unmatched trials
calibration_selection: for each target subject and gesture, choose the lowest SHA-256 of '20260928|subject|gesture|trial' within each scheduled force bucket; without replacement; prefixes define nested 1/2/5-shot sets

evaluation.unseen_high: all target-subject force-code-2 active trials at every budget; no high-force calibration or target evaluation labels used for adaptation
evaluation.product_all: all active target trials except the five reserved calibration trials per gesture; identical evaluation trials at budgets 0/1/2/5

population_model: source-subject StandardScaler and balanced logistic model from the prior fixed screen; predictions must exactly replay before calibration
prototype_model: mean of source-scaled, equal-trial-mass three-window feature vectors per target calibration gesture; local probabilities softmax of negative squared Euclidean distances divided by twice feature dimension and a source-only within-class trial variance median
blend: p=(1-alpha)*p_population+alpha*p_personal; alpha=shots/(shots+5), fixed for all subjects/arms/force modes; no target test tuning
boundaries: Protocol A personal calibration only; no same-user cross-session profile exists in public DS2
force categories are subjective, not measured mechanical force
previously inspected final subjects make this descriptive
new F1 is not historical X1-H
